Select the first 200 metabolism records for enzyme CYP2B6. Join metabolism to compound_records on substrate_record_id to get the substrate molregno, then join to compound_structures for canonical_smiles and molecule_dictionary for substrate_compound_name. Optionally join molecule_hierarchy from the substrate molregno to parent_molregno and then to molecule_dictionary to retrieve parent_compound_name. Return columns canonical_smiles, substrate_compound_name, parent_compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism, and enzyme_name. Do not add sorting; preserve source row order.
